lines: Hello, Sonic Wanderer{s}! Welcome to the field.
Drift around and explore the field.
It's full of music waiting to happen. You'll be jamming in no time.
Now charge through the field to generate musical potential.
Careful, that vessel of yours can burn through energy fast.
Especially with those heavier sounds.
Looks like you've attracted some attention...
Discoveries are drawn to the energy you've stirred up.
The hungriest ones have the most potential.
It's ready to be harvested!
It might be a little tricky to reach.
Get it!
That's it!
Tease out that melody!
Can you hear it?
Go catch one!
Listen. The note you caught has gone quiet where it used to play.
That note won't be heard again unless you place it.
Now it's part of the loop!
You hear it play as it wraps around?
Now catch some more.
Place them anywhere there's an open spot.
If you miss the timing window... watch out!
You've completed your first ring!
It's coming together.
Let's finish the rest of this record.
It got away!
Keep stirring things up. There's more to discover.
Discarded!
You meant to do that, right?
